recipes.name: Chocolate Pudding (4 Ways) inspired by Rugrats
ingredients: 3/4 cup self rising flour (or same amount of all purpose flour sifted with 2 tsp baking powder)
instructions: for the Snack Pack
Start by combing My-T-Fine pudding packet with cold milk over medium heat. Whisk together until thick. - 2 cups milk - 1 box My*T*Fine Pudding
Pour into a serving bowl of choice, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
for the From Scratch

In a medium saucepan, combine sugar, cocoa powder and cornstarch and whisk together. Once combined, add egg yolks and heavy cream. Whisk to combine. - ½ cup sugar - 3 tbsp cocoa powder - 2 tbsp cornstarch - 2 egg yolks - ½ cup heavy cream

After everything is smoothly whisked together, add whole milk and whisk together vigorously over medium heat until it comes to a boil. Look for even bubble coverage each time you stop whisking. - 2 ½ cups whole milk

At this time, kill the heat and add chopped dark chocolate along with unsalted butter. Next add espresso powder, vanilla extract, and kosher salt. Whisk together until completely mixed. - 4 oz chopped dark chocolate - 5 tbsp unsalted butter - ½ tsp espresso powder - 1 tsp vanilla extract - ½ tsp kosher salt
Once the ingredients are completely mixed, strain into a large bowl to eliminate any lumps of leftover cornstarch.
Pour into a serving bowl(s) of choice, let cool for about 20 minutes and cover with plastic wrap. Chill in the fridge for at least 4 hours.
For the Pot du Creme
In a small saucepan, add heavy cream and whole milk. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. - 1 cup heavy cream - ¼ cup whole milk

Once simmering, kill the heat and add chopped chocolate, espresso powder, and kosher salt. Whisk rigorously together until everything is melted and smooth. - 4 oz chopped chocolate - ¼ tsp espresso powder - ¼ tsp kosher salt
On a prep table, separate egg yolks into a large mixing bowl and mix together with sugar. - 3 egg yolks - 2 tbsp sugar
Once that is smooth, slowly pour the chocolate mixture in, while whisking together constantly.
After mixing together, place it into a bain marie. Nestle four ramekins onto a kitchen towel placed into a casserole and pour the custard evenly into each ramekin.
Make sure that each ramekin is level and then surround them with boiling water that comes halfway up the ramekins. Place a lid on top of the casserole and place it into a 325°F for 25-35 minutes.
Once finished, take the ramekins out of the casserole dish and let cool on a cooling rack until the texture is jiggly but set.
For the Australian Pudding

Into a small bowl goes brown sugar, granulated sugar, and cocoa powder. Mix together using your fingers until everything is smooth and combined. - ⅓ cup brown sugar - ⅓ cup granulated sugar - ⅓ cup cocoa powder

In a 10-inch cast iron skillet, combine chopped chocolate, unsalted butter, cocoa powder. Whisk together over medium heat until it all mixes together. - 2 oz chopped chocolate - 6 oz unsalted butter - ⅓ cup cocoa powder

In a large mixing bowl, combine granulated sugar, egg yolk, whole milk, vanilla extract and kosher salt. Mix together. - ⅔ cup granulated sugar - 1 egg yolk - ⅓ cup whole milk - 1 tbsp vanilla extract - ½ tsp kosher salt

Slowly pour the egg yolk mixture into the still warm chocolate mixture while whisking constantly. Once that is all mixed together, add self rising flour and whisk together until it resembles a cake-like batter. Top it with the brown sugar mixture by sprinkling it evenly across the top. - ¾ cup self rising flour (or same amount of all purpose flour sifted with 2 tsp baking powder)
Pour fresh brewed coffee, or boiling water, on top and place the cast iron into a 325°F for 30-35 minutes. Let cool for 15 minutes before serving in a bowl - 1 cup boiling water (or 1 cup coffee)
